short_description: RC Library management for rubrics, reading-circle content, evaluation forms, and reporting workflows.
author: StageKitWP
name: stagekitwp-rc-library

sections.description: The RC Library plugin manages rubric items, templates, circle groups, and evaluation form workflows for the StageKitWP ecosystem.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-rc-library plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/ and activate it from the Plugins screen.
sections.changelog: Release notes are maintained in the plugin repository.
